units.name: Logistics and Operations Management
units.evidence: Official research page names Logistics and Operations Management among five interdisciplinary research fields and states university research excellence in logistics, operations and supply chain.

units.name: Environmental Sustainability of Supply Chains
units.evidence: Official named research field examines logistics environmental impacts, waste management in supply chains and circular economy.

decisions.reason: Official research structure provides a named Logistics and Operations Management field; imported posting shorthand does not establish a separate department.
